The Lantern Gazette

Gulls learn the ferry timetable

Harbour gulls arrive at the north pier four minutes before each ferry docks, the keeper's log shows over a whole season.

The birds gather on the railings, wait for the gangway, and leave once the last car has rolled off the deck.

On the two days the ferry did not sail, the gulls came anyway and left at the usual time, which the keeper wrote down twice.

The last paragraph says the timetable is posted beside the ticket window.
